description: The spec's foundational invariant is 'NO human in the loop' (line 15-18) and INV-MODE 'a self-funded instance MUST NOT depend on any human credential' (line 62), with self-funded declared the ~100% default (line 30-34). This is not reconciled with the only spawn implementation, which REQUIRES a human to complete the on-chain USDC seed: run.sh:196 only prints 'Seed the child wallet with $X and it wakes on its own' — the seed transfer is a manual human step, not an on-chain automated action. The spec even concedes at line 44 that a self-funded instance 'must be seeded USDC first — even to start on cloud.' A design whose bootstrap mandates a human USDC seed cannot simultaneously claim self-funded/no-human-in-loop as the default at ~100%. This central tension is asserted away in prose (§1/§2/§8 say 'on-chain spawn a self-funded clone') rather than resolved or surfaced as an open question.

evidence.snippet: self-funded % must trend to ~100% ... a self-funded instance MUST NOT depend on any human credential ... must be seeded USDC first — even to start on cloud
contradictedBy: /Users/operator/anicca/skills/self/spawn/run.sh:196 (seed = printed human instruction, not automated on-chain transfer)
